title: Chapter 215: All Four Tribes' Territories Are In Hand
content:
Chapter 215: All Four Tribes' Territories Are In Hand

The nearest branch of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce is far away from this special area. It will waste a lot of time to transport personnel and materials through the space transmission channel there and then transfer them here.

The space transmission channel built by the Naga tribe here connects to the Naga tribe’s territory, where there is a branch of the Goblin Chamber of Commerce.

Through the Goblin Chamber of Commerce branch in the Naga tribe’s territory, people and materials can be transported directly to here through the Naga tribe’s space transmission channel, which is very fast and safe.

Gong Zhe stated that the Goblin Chamber of Commerce built this space transmission channel, in addition to supporting the development of the Zerg, mainly to facilitate the Zerg to enter the main battlefield of the camp war.

If the Zerg wants to grow and develop, it needs to go out and go to the main battlefield of the camp war, which is the stage that the whole world is paying attention to. Only there can it kill enemies to its heart’s content, continue to become famous, and prove the identity of the Zerg clan with practical actions.

In the native race camp, if there is not enough battlefield contribution, it is not a real clan.

The clan is not only based on strength, but also on contribution.

Of course, the Goblins also have their own selfish reasons for supporting the development of the Zerg. They need more Zerg energy coins. These high-purity energy coins have an immeasurable impact on the Goblins.

It is a good thing to win over a potential large tribe that has just entered the world with all your strength, and there are huge practical benefits to be gained.

"You must maintain the space transmission channel left by our tribe. This is the bond between our two tribes!"

"When you want to fight in the future and have nowhere to go, you are welcome to come to our battlefield. I promise to let you fight happily!"

Naga said to Wu Qing.

She can see that the Zerg will get benefits from fighting, and they will fight very hard for the sake of fighting.

Since the Naga army fought side by side with the Zerg army, the Naga army has basically had nothing to do, and the enemies have been snatched away by the Zerg.

In the previous battle, the Naga army was completely reduced to a spectator.

Naga, like Gong Zhe, was optimistic about the Zerg. She decided to leave the precious space transmission channel to keep the two tribes in contact. Only by frequent exchanges can this friendship be maintained.

After the matter was settled, Gong Zhe said goodbye and left first. He had a lot of things to do now and had no time to chat here.

Naga and Wu Qing had a face-to-face communication on the details of the Naga evacuation for the last time. After this separation, the two should not meet again in a short time.

Of course, Wu Qing can possess Host No. 3 to communicate with Naga at any time, but Naga doesn't know it.

After everything was finalized, Wu Qing handed over more than 10,000 Zerg destroyers to Naga on the spot. Zerg destroyers were no longer useful in the next cleanup battle, so there was no need to drag them.

Host No. 3 also rushed over from the Zerg reinforcements, and Nagalong came with it. The demon tribe's territory was all handed over to the Zerg, and the Naga tribe no longer needed to specify the attack target.

All subsequent combat operations will be decided by the Zerg themselves.

Naga was very satisfied with the powerful Zerg destroyer led by Host No. 3. Wu Qing's straightforwardness greatly increased her favorability.

"I will keep a batch of luck beads as the hiring fee for this army!"

"Later, I will pay the corresponding hiring fee according to the performance of this army on the battlefield!"

Naga said to Wu Qing.

Wu Qing knew that Naga said it here on purpose, which must be a large number of luck beads. He was also very satisfied with this result.

As long as there are enough resources, it won't take much time to build another strong army.

This is equivalent to Naga buying a Zerg army and going out to help the Zerg make money. Such good things should be done often in the future.

After the Zerg's affairs here are all dealt with and there are idle troops, Wu Qing is ready to continue to support Naga.

A large tribe is like a country, and there are many branches in it. Naga represents the Naga tribe and also represents one of its branches.

Wu Qing must support the Naga tribe, and even more so Naga. It is very beneficial for the Zerg to have such a friendly person with a certain status in the large tribe.

Naga left with Host No. 3 and the Zerg Destroyer. Now this place has become Wu Qing's home ground, and she no longer needs to arrange it.

The Naga territory, after Naga takes away the tribe members and the army and other related personnel, will retain a complete management system and basic security protection. As long as the evil god camp does not attack in large numbers, there will be no big problem.

The Zerg only needs to go and receive it when necessary. Even if they don't receive it, these territories can manage themselves and operate normally.

Naga did this, which saved Wu Qing a lot of trouble.

Wu Qing did not stop either. If the Zerg wants to completely control this area, there are still many things to do.

The Zerg dragon group that had just captured the Demon Clan's castle began to sweep the Demon Clan's frontline castles. Most of the garrisons in these frontline castles fell in the previous battle, and now the defenses of each castle are very weak.

The Zerg ground forces will be divided into several groups, and together with the original Zerg reinforcements, they will attack the main garrison castles in the Demon Clan's territory.

These Zerg ground main combat forces will only return to the Zerg territory after completely eliminating the main remaining forces of the Demon Clan army in the Demon Clan's territory. During this period, they will stay in the Demon Clan's territory.

With today's battle, the system's resources have become sufficient again. The Zerg territory is constantly hatching Zerg puppies. A large number of Zerg puppies enter the Zerg territory, taking various cities and strongholds as the center to control the surrounding areas.

More Zerg puppies enter the Demon territory from all directions to clear out the small group of Demon garrisons.

Another large number of Zerg hosts are dispatched, focusing on entering the Tengu and Demon territories, monitoring the movements of the cities in the Tengu territories, and collecting detailed intelligence on the Demon territories.

…

The Tengu representative returned to the Tengu territory from the Naga territory and immediately reported in detail to the elder Gou Hong.

After he explained all the details clearly, he added: "Elder, the strange killing methods of the Zerg are hard to guard against, and it seems that they are deliberately showing them to our tribe!"

This representative is Gou Hong's confidant. Because the situation this time is special, he was sent to be a representative.

He said many things truthfully without hiding anything.

"Do the elders want to meet with the Zerg leader?"

Gou Hong remained silent, closed his eyes and listened to his trusted subordinates reporting everything they saw.

"I'm old and don't want to compete with these young people!"

"I've been here for so long, it's time to go back!"

"Tell the little ancestor about these situations and see what he thinks!"

"As for the others, tell them that they can make trouble if they want, but life and death are up to fate!"

After Gou Hong said this, he closed his eyes again and kept silent.

"Yes! Elders!"

The Tengu representative withdrew and did things according to the request of the Tengu elder Gou Hong.

The little ancestor mentioned by Gou Hong was Gou Bao. At this time, Gou Bao was training his Zerg biological colonization troops. Relying on his wild and imaginative ideas, he played a lot of tricks with the Zerg biological colonization.

When the news brought back by the representative of the Tengu tribe was delivered to him, he just glanced at it casually. When he saw that Wu Qing said that compensation could be given, he was immediately happy.

"This damn place, they still say that they come here to encounter opportunities. If they continue to encounter opportunities, I will become an old baby!"

"With this excuse, I can just go back openly!"

"This Zerg lord has such a big advantage and is willing to give compensation. Not bad!"

"Go and ask me for the Zerg biological colonization equipment! As many as you can! I will reward you if you ask for more!"

"I deliberately tricked him once. I don't know if he will hold a grudge! They now have that kind of weird killing method. I'd better go back first!"

Gou Bao packed up and left without saying a word.

As he walked, he said to people: "As long as you can get the Zerg biological colonization equipment, give them the luck beads if they want them. Don't be stingy!"

Gou Bao also knew that the Zerg needed luck beads. He made a pre-warning in advance to avoid ruining his good fortune.

Other high-ranking members of the Tengu tribe also received the news and warnings. Each of them had different thoughts, but if they refused to leave, they would be beaten. They were not as strong as others, so they had no choice.

As for whether to make some small moves, it depends on whether they cherish their lives. From the Zerg's style of doing things, it can be seen that the Zerg really dare to do it to them.

If the silent killing method is true, if they really kill them, no one can find the murderer, and no one will help them to avenge.

These people cherish their lives and dare not make small moves. It is still possible to plunder them legitimately. For a time, the entire Tengu territory became turbulent.

The Zerg host visited various cities in the Tengu territory openly and silently paid attention to the situation in these cities, which made the Tengu people dare not be too presumptuous.

When Wu Qing received the news that Gou Bao wanted the Zerg biological colonization suit as compensation, he knew the choice of the Tengu tribe.

In the past, the Zerg's strength was not obvious, and the Tengu tribe could still take various actions with a high-handed attitude.

Now the strength of the Zerg has been recognized by the Naga, Goblin and many other forces. If the Tengu still dares to treat the Zerg with the same attitude as before, it will be difficult to resolve the hatred once it is formed.

There are no real fools who can make a name for themselves in the big tribes.

For the Zerg biological colonization suits that Gou Bao needs, Wu Qing is ready to satisfy his wish.

Gou Bao's ability is still very strong. The biological colonization troops he trained have indeed developed many abilities of the Zerg biological colonization suits, some of which have been collected by the Queen of the Zerg.

Moreover, sending the Zerg biological colonization suits to the Tengu tribe will bring many benefits to the Zerg.

Wu Qing is ready to give Gou Bao 10,000 sets of Zerg biological colonization suits as compensation. If he wants to buy, he will provide them at the same price as last time, with no limit on the number.

Given the relationship between the Zerg and the Tengu tribe, the Tengu tribe's space transmission channel will definitely not stay, and it will not be easy to sell Zerg biological colonization suits to Gou Bao in the future.
